en:
Man, I'm bushed. I got no motivation at all.
And Monophanie's period is late, too.
*gasp!*

Father... Why do you know Monophanie's
cycle...?

Never mind that... Perhaps this lack of
motivation is due to a lack of hibernation.
Lack of hibernation...?

Yeah... I haven't been sleeping well lately,
so I haven't really been able to hibernate...
That's awful... What could be causing it?
Is it cuz you have a lot on your mind?
Hmm...

Is it cuz the graveyard shift pays
a better hourly wage?
Hmmmm...

Is it cuz you don't want them to think
you're just goofing around?
Hmmmmmm...
Is it cuz you wanna stay friends?
Hmmmmmmmm...
Is it cuz you wanna watch it in real-time?
...Father?

He's gone into hibernation...
We should let him be...
Yeah, you're right... Night, night.
Ugh! M-My head!
Monotaro, pull yourself together!

I-I feel like I'm forgetting someone important
to me, but...ugh...I-I just can't...

M-My head! My head hurts so much,
I just can't remember...

...If you've forgotten, maybe that's
for the best.

From this point forward, let's start
a new life for ourselves.

After all...our baby is excited to meet
his daddy, y'know?

...Daddy? Wait, WHAT!?
I'm gonna be a father!?
